parole.significato: for, for the sake of (with the purpose of helping, serving, preserving, or achieving something)
master, landlord, householder, manager of owndom, husband (in its archaic sense)
parole.testo: From an earlier стопа́н (stopán) (dialectal) + -ин (-in) (agentive suffix). Formally reflects Proto-Slavic *stopan(in)ъ which yielded Old Church Slavonic стопанъ (stopanŭ), Serbo-Croatian стопан, Macedonian стопан (stopan) and was loaned into Romanian stăpân, but beyond that - of uncertain origin.
